unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a governed policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths for regulated deployments.
- bul_unify_002: Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based subscription forecasting to sustain renewal growth.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by embedding context engineering and runtime resilience controls across evaluation gates and rollback pathways.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle to compress deployment from six months to three weeks, applying managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design across intake, validation, and monitoring stages.
- bul_unify_005: Established high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing agentic platform productization and an operating model for agentic AI that converted delivery into reusable commercial IP.
